outcome: Incidence of obstetric anal sphincter injuries (OASIS)
finding: The incidence of OASIS in Wales increased significantly from 1999 to 2009, coinciding with an increase in episiotomy and forceps deliveries, a decrease in ventouse deliveries, and an increase in caesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: The incidence of OASIS increased alongside a significant increase in episiotomy and forceps delivery, a drop in ventouse deliveries, and an increase in caesarean delivery.
